title: A number column sorts highest first on the first click
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing three new categories made for this test.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix B, pricing one new category made for this test.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click the Categories column header.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A and matrix B are listed.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A (3 categories) is above matrix B (1 category).
  • Matrices with more categories come before those with fewer.
